_about: A raw FreeCAD context for the corpus, recorded with tools/record_context.py.

descriptions.PartDesign_AdditiveHelix: Sweeps the selected sketch or profile along a helix and adds it to the body
descriptions.PartDesign_AdditiveLoft: Lofts the selected sketch or profile along a path and adds it to the body
descriptions.PartDesign_AdditivePipe: Sweeps the selected sketch or profile along a path and adds it to the body
descriptions.PartDesign_Body: Creates a new body and activates it
descriptions.PartDesign_Boolean: Applies boolean operations with the selected objects and the active body
descriptions.PartDesign_Chamfer: Applies a chamfer to the selected edges or faces
descriptions.PartDesign_Clone: Copies a solid object parametrically as the base feature of a new body
descriptions.PartDesign_CompPrimitiveAdditive: Creates an additive box by its width, height, and length
descriptions.PartDesign_CompPrimitiveSubtractive: Creates a subtractive box by its width, height and length
descriptions.PartDesign_Draft: Applies a draft to the selected faces
descriptions.PartDesign_Fillet: Applies a fillet to the selected edges or faces
descriptions.PartDesign_Groove: Revolves the sketch or profile around a line or axis and removes it from the body
descriptions.PartDesign_Hole: Creates holes in the active body at the center points of circles or arcs of the selected sketch or profile
descriptions.PartDesign_LinearPattern: Duplicates the selected features or the active body in a linear pattern
descriptions.PartDesign_Mirrored: Mirrors the selected features or active body
descriptions.PartDesign_MultiTransform: Applies multiple transformations to the selected features or active body
descriptions.PartDesign_Pad: Extrudes the selected sketch or profile and adds it to the body
descriptions.PartDesign_Pocket: Extrudes the selected sketch or profile and removes it from the body
descriptions.PartDesign_PolarPattern: Duplicates the selected features or the active body in a circular pattern
descriptions.PartDesign_Revolution: Revolves the selected sketch or profile around a line or axis and adds it to the body
descriptions.PartDesign_SubShapeBinder: Creates a reference to geometry from one or more objects, allowing it to be used inside or outside a body. It tracks relative placements, supports multiple geometry types (solids, faces, edges, vertices), and can work with objects in the same or external documents.
descriptions.PartDesign_SubtractiveHelix: Sweeps the selected sketch or profile along a helix and removes it from the body
descriptions.PartDesign_SubtractiveLoft: Lofts the selected sketch or profile along a path and removes it from the body
descriptions.PartDesign_SubtractivePipe: Sweeps the selected sketch or profile along a path and removes it from the body
descriptions.PartDesign_Thickness: Applies thickness and removes the selected faces
descriptions.Part_CheckGeometry: Analyzes the selected shapes for errors
descriptions.Part_Datums: Creates a coordinate system that can be attached to other objects
descriptions.Part_SelectFilter: Only allows the selection of vertices
descriptions.Sketcher_ValidateSketch:
Validates a sketch by checking for missing coincidences,
invalid constraints, and degenerate geometry
descriptions.Std_AlignToSelection: Aligns the camera view to the selected elements in the 3D view
descriptions.Std_Copy: Copies the selection to the clipboard
descriptions.Std_Cut: Removes the selection and copies it to the clipboard
descriptions.Std_DlgMacroExecute: Opens a dialog to execute a recorded macro
descriptions.Std_DlgMacroExecuteDirect: Executes the macro in the editor
descriptions.Std_DlgMacroRecord: Opens a dialog to record a macro
descriptions.Std_Group: Creates a group, which is a general-purpose container to group objects in the tree view, regardless of their data type. It is a simple folder to organize the objects in a model.
descriptions.Std_LinkActions: A link is an object that references another object, either within the same or in another document. Unlike clones, links reference the original shape directly, making them more memory-efficient, which helps with the creation of complex assemblies.
descriptions.Std_Open: Opens a document or imports files
descriptions.Std_Part: Creates a part, which is a general-purpose container to group objects so they act as a unit in the 3D view. It is intended to arrange objects that have a part TopoShape, like part primitives, Part Design bodies, and other parts.
descriptions.Std_Paste: Pastes the contents of the clipboard
descriptions.Std_TreeViewActions: Switches to the 3D view containing the selected item from the tree view
descriptions.Std_VarSet: Creates a variable set, which is an object that maintains a set of properties to be used as variables
descriptions.Std_ViewBottom: Sets the camera to the bottom view
descriptions.Std_ViewFitAll: Fits all content into the 3D view
descriptions.Std_ViewFitSelection: Fits the selected content into the 3D view
descriptions.Std_ViewFront: Sets the camera to the front view
descriptions.Std_ViewGroup: Sets the camera to the isometric view
descriptions.Std_ViewIsometric: Sets the camera to the isometric view
descriptions.Std_ViewLeft: Sets the camera to the left view
descriptions.Std_ViewRear: Sets the camera to the rear view
descriptions.Std_ViewRight: Sets the camera to the right view
descriptions.Std_ViewTop: Sets the camera to the top view
descriptions.Std_WhatsThis: Opens the documentation for the selected command
descriptions.TalkToMe_Microphone: Talk to me: switch the microphone on or off

note: PartDesign: the pad dialog is open and asks for its length
